data.headline: Staff Software Engineer - Reliability @ Robinhood
data.about: Staff+ engineer specializing in platform infrastructure, reliability, and developer experience. I build the systems and define the strategies that help engineering organizations ship safely at scale — from large-scale observability platforms to multi-region architectures to CI/CD frameworks.At Robinhood I founded the Reliability team and established company-wide standards for service tiering, incident management, and AI-assisted engineering. At Coinbase I led the Observability team and authored the multi-region active/active strategy that kept critical systems running through major AWS outages. Before that, I spent 6 years at AWS training thousands of engineers and architects across the full stack.I care deeply about improving the quality of life of fellow engineers — whether that means building better tooling, mentoring teammates through career growth, or designing systems that are a pleasure to operate.

experiences.title: Tech Lead, Staff Software Engineer — Reliability & Engineering Excellence
experiences.subtitle: Robinhood . undefined
experiences.caption: Mar 2025 - Present · 10 mos

description.text:
Founded Robinhood's Reliability team — defined its mission, hired the team, and set technical and strategic direction from zero.

RELIABILITY STRATEGY & POLICY

Authored the company's Service Tiering Policy, synthesizing input from senior ICs across the org to formalize service classification and reliability requirements per tier. The framework became the foundation for deployment, on-call, and incident response standards company-wide.

Designed and implemented Critical User Journey (CUJ) instrumentation — end-to-end monitoring and alerting across front-end and back-end — surfacing early failure signals for previously unmonitored features. Redesigned load testing strategy for previously untested production bottlenecks.

DEVELOPER TOOLING & CD

Extended the internal CD system to enforce deploy freeze windows by application tier, with an exception request and approval workflow requiring manager or higher-privilege sign-off. Centralized ownership of fragmented reliability tools across business units, driving adoption of unified tooling.

INCIDENT MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

Took ownership of the internal incident management platform (Slack-integrated web app with LLM-powered root cause analysis). Revitalized a previously unmaintained tool — collected org-wide feature requests, analyzed usage patterns, and shipped improvements.

Authored and formalized the Global SEV Review process — a weekly cross-company meeting attended by senior ICs and executives where teams present root cause, impact, and mitigation for closed incidents. I facilitate the reviews and Q&A, driving accountability and learning across engineering.

AI/LLM ENGINEERING STRATEGY

Drove adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across Robinhood as the company's subject matter expert on Claude Code — advising teams on LLM-agent-friendly workflows, architecting AI-optimized deployment processes with the Staging team, and collaborating with the GenAI team on company-wide strategy.
Advised startups and mid-size companies on AWS architecture, security posture, and cost optimization.

experiences.title: Staff Software Engineer — Infrastructure, Observability & Developer Platform
experiences.subtitle: Coinbase . Full-time
experiences.caption: Aug 2020 - Feb 2025 · 4 yrs 6 mos

description.text:
OBSERVABILITY — Tech Lead, 10-person team

Designed and built a deployment system for stateful services (ClickHouse, Mimir, Grafana), partnering with Security, Compute, and DevX to make it reusable and compliant. Later adopted by Online Storage to deploy CockroachDB for benchmarking against Aurora.

Authored the company's multi-region active/active strategy after the 2020 AWS us-east-1 outage and implemented it for the first service — the Log Pipeline, a stateful system. When a subsequent major outage took down most services, the Log Pipeline kept running. The SVP of Engineering cited it as the standard the rest of the company should have followed.

DEVELOPER TOOLING, CI/CD & CODE QUALITY

Designed and built a deployment system for stateful services (ClickHouse, Mimir, Grafana), partnering with Security and Compute to make it reusable and compliant. Later adopted by Online Storage to deploy CockroachDB for benchmarking against Aurora.

Built Go static analysis tooling and custom Bazel CI rules to catch risky patterns (e.g. PII leak risks in logs) before they shipped. Built a performance regression framework as a Buildkite pipeline — spinning up isolated environments, running statistical before/after analysis, and blocking merges on significant regressions.

DATA STORES

Built the control plane for the ClickHouse and CockroachDB fleet. Designed distributed database benchmarking tooling — stress-testing PostgreSQL (RDS), Aurora, CockroachDB, and MongoDB at hardware saturation to drive long-term technology decisions.

Redesigned Coinbase's internal MongoDB Go driver for extensibility and automated a major version migration across 200+ projects.

Optimized the PII + Secret Redaction system, achieving 50% cost savings (>$1M/year). Mentored engineers from junior to senior, guiding multiple promotion cycles.
Built tooling to automate data extraction from commodity reports, analyze real-time option market data, and automate execution of option strategies.

experiences.subtitle: Amazon Web Services (AWS) . undefined
experiences.caption: Aug 2013 - Sep 2019 · 6 yrs 1 mo
experiences.metadata: São Paulo, Brazil -> San Francisco, CA

description.text:
Delivered hundreds of multi-day, instructor-led training sessions across the full breadth of AWS — Architecture, Advanced Architecture, Security Operations, DevOps, Big Data, Systems Operations, and Development — to audiences ranging from business executives to senior software architects.

Lead instructor for AWS's Advanced Architecture and Security Operations courses. Created training material, labs, and live demos. Known for on-the-fly creation of production-quality code across multiple languages and paradigms during live sessions to illustrate best practices.

Public speaker at scale: delivered full-day talks to audiences of hundreds at AWSome Day events (Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Boston, Atlanta) and AWS Summits in São Paulo and globally.

Helped expand AWS Training's business in Brazil — working directly with vendors, partners, and customers. Trained and onboarded new hires in Amazon values, AWS technology, and training delivery.

Joined as a software engineer and single-handedly redesigned the platform from a fragile monolith into a scalable, AWS-based architecture serving 5M+ unique visitors and 10M+ hits/month.

Introduced AWS to the company and led the full migration. Designed and built from scratch: a sharded MySQL database system with a custom Hibernate-based framework that made sharding completely transparent to application code, async document processing pipelines, a search engine, HTML preview generation for multiple document formats, a machine learning-based piracy detection system, and a complete email marketing platform (list management, bounce processing, campaign delivery).
At beezBEEZ, I worked as a Software Developer in 3 projects, including the complete development of a CRM tool -- from requirements analysis and system architecture to full development and deployment.

projects.title: Homelab — Secure, Production-Grade Kubernetes on Bare Metal
projects.subtitle: 2024 - Present

description.text:
Built and operate a high-availability Kubernetes cluster on 5 Raspberry Pis + Synology NAS, designed with a full hardware-rooted chain of trust.

The OS is a custom stripped-down Alpine Linux running entirely from an initramfs in RAM, with secure boot and LUKS-encrypted NVMe persistence (keys stored in Pi OTP, accessible only on verified boot). Two nodes boot from SD and serve as the cluster's network foundation (DHCP, DNS, PKI via StepCA, Tailscale access, reverse proxy via Caddy), while the remaining three network-boot from them via HTTP and form an HA Kubernetes cluster running K3s.

The entire build system is driven by Bazel with custom Starlark rules for building initramfs and bootable disk images.

Because shipping reliable infrastructure is what I do for fun, too.
